thread:
maria: @channel seeing aborted pages for inc-assist (alert id: ia-824). Pager bridge returns 502 when posting to /v1/publish. No obvious error spikes in upstream service logs.

devon: on it. can someone paste the exact curl payload/response?

maria: here's a quick curl I ran from prod-tools box:
```
curl -i -X POST https://pagerbridge.prod.internal/v1/publish \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"policy":"auto","recipient":"oncall-sre"}'

HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{ "error": "upstream read timeout" }
```

jon: ops-bot created incident INC-2024-824 (ops-bot:incident). Pager-assist-bot posted suppression summary: no pages sent for ~15m.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-824 created by maria. Severity: P2. Affected product regions: us-east-1. Escalation: not yet triggered.

sre-oncall: I'm online, will join. quick question — are downstream SMS gateways flapping or is it upstream to pagerbridge?

devon: initial hypothesis: an edge caching proxy (pgw-edge) started returning 502 after cert rotation failure w/ OpenSSL handshake retries. I see TLS 0x1408 errors in nginx on pgw-edge-2.

maria: confirmed logs from pgw-edge-2: "AH02032: tlsv1 alert unknown ca" and then 502s to pagerbridge. No config changes pushed in last 24h.

jon: customer impact? any live pages lost to customers or only internal ops pages?

maria: two customer tenants (acme-co, bluewave) reported "no pages received" to their escalation policies. I flagged both to support and sent external acknowledgement.

devon: rolling a quick workaround: route traffic around pgw-edge-2 via PGW service LB weight shift. running:
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it svc/pgw-controller -- sh -c "curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:9000/weight-adjust?node=pgw-edge-2&weight=0"
```

devon: executed weight shift, verifying metrics.

maria: after weight shift, pagerbridge POSTs are succeeding from prod-tools (200 OK). paging resumed ~2m ago.

ops-bot: Pager-assist-bot suppression lifted automatically after 2 successful publishes.

sre-oncall: nice mitigation. next: we need root cause — cert rotation job ran at 03:00 and failed to upload chain to S3 due to transient IAM Deny. open a ticket with infra. Also add healthcheck for TLS handshake errors to alert before suppression triggers.

jon: did the incidentbot automation handle handoffs correctly? I noticed oncall wasn't paged initially even though suppression was lifted.

maria: looks like incidentbot treated the suppression window as active and skipped page attempts until manual retry. I forced a manual page for oncall at 1712350200 which went through. We should patch incidentbot to re-check queue on suppression-clear.

devon: filed GHPR #8453 to add post-suppression requeue + unit test. assigning to @devon and @jon for review.

maria: customer comms: support sent targeted RCAs to acme-co and bluewave, offered manual callouts for any missed oncalls.

jon: rolling postmortem ops: short timeline, mitigation steps, code change link, and action items (cert rotation hardening, incidentbot requeue, pgw-edge autoscaling). I'll draft and share in #postmortems.

sre-oncall: marking INC-2024-824 as mitigated. will keep open for RCA until tomorrow. thanks all for quick triage :thumbsup:
